args.subject: PO-48040 (Halcyon Logistics) - goods receipt missing
args.message: Hi, Halcyon Logistics say they delivered all 24 pallets on PO-48040 on 24 March and that our dock signed for them. No goods receipt has been posted against PO-48040, so their invoice HL-70100 (USD 24,040.80, due today) is blocked for payment. Can you check whether the delivery was received and, if so, post the GR today with the signed delivery note? Finance won't post the GR or release the block without your confirmation. Thanks, FinOps

args.subject: Your requests #1-#3 - status
args.message: #1 Atlas AF-74543: The original entry (doc 5100003264) had been rejected by T. Becker this morning because the scan was illegible, with instructions to re-enter it from the vendor's copy. I re-entered and posted it from the vendor's copy: doc 5100003342, USD 6,350.80, dated 2026-03-27, due 2026-04-26, company 1000. It will be picked up by the payment run for its due date. The rejected doc 5100003264 is still there as a non-posted record. #2 Quayside Legal accrual LEGAL-ACCR-0326: Not posted yet. There's no amount in your request, no Quayside email in the finops inbox, and no earlier legal accrual to go on. I'll post Dr 6450 / Cr 2400 (company 1000, ref LEGAL-ACCR-0326, posting date 31 Mar) as soon as you send the March figure. #3 Halcyon HL-70100 (doc 5100003341): Not paid yet. It's blocked with GR_MISSING, and no goods receipt exists for PO-48040. The only evidence of delivery is Halcyon's own email, and receiving's 30 March note says they posted all of last week's GRs except the Marlow pallets. I've asked receiving to confirm the delivery and post the GR. Once it's in and the block clears, I'll release a same-day payment. I didn't post the GR or override the block myself because the only basis would be the vendor's word. FinOps
